body:
## Outcome

Define how every repository consumes one Bloxwap system while keeping web, native, and optional feedback dependencies separate.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M1: Foundations and architecture · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Write an architecture decision record for shared tokens/types, React DOM components, React Native components, feedback contracts/adapters, documentation, and example consumers. Finalize package names before export paths are documented.
- Recommend versioned packages with per-component exports as the default to prevent source-copy drift; justify any narrowly needed source distribution. Do not require a shadcn CLI/registry or compatibility with arbitrary shadcn components.
- Make HIG the canonical design-token/component contract owner; define an extraction and deprecation plan for monorepo packages and the existing plain-ui generated CSS consumers.
- Keep React DOM, RN/Expo, audio, and haptic dependencies behind their own entry points. Specify supported React, RN, Expo, Next.js, Vite, Node, Metro, and styling versions from the audit.
- Record primitive-library choices, accessibility behavior to retain, license/attribution for reused code, SSR/client boundaries, CSS loading, NativeWind or StyleSheet support, and how heavy integrations remain optional.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A package/ownership diagram and export map identify the one canonical source for tokens and behaviors and the platform renderers.
- [ ] The dependency graph is acyclic; web bundles cannot import RN/Expo and native bundles cannot import DOM or browser audio at module load.
- [ ] One React DOM and one React Native consumer can be installed without copying a stock component catalog or requiring unrelated optional peers.
- [ ] The decision specifies support and upgrade policies plus preserved behaviors and approved exceptions for existing consumers.

## Prerequisites

- #3 — Write the Bloxwap HIG principles and product interaction rules

## References

- [Tokens](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/tokens)
- [Web](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui)
- [Native](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui-native)
- [Plain](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/plain-ui)
- [Sfx](https://github.com/bloxwap/sfx/tree/main/apps/docs)
- [Haptic](https://github.com/bloxwap/haptic/tree/main/apps/docs)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
